---
title: "simstim forward"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Forward a session's ports to localhost (all of them if none are given).

```text
simstim forward <host>/<session> [port…]
```

Forwards ports from the host to 127.0.0.1 on this machine, through your SSH connection, until you press Ctrl+C. Write local:remote to use another local port. Nothing is exposed beyond this machine.

## Examples

```sh
simstim forward my-vps/web 3000
simstim forward my-vps/web 8080:3000
```
